This is the same model as the manager app `shiny/production`. There, the class moves sliders. Here the marked block is those sliders.

The peak of the curve is MSY. $B_{MSY}$ is the biomass at the peak. $F_{MSY}$ is MSY divided by $B_{MSY}$. The trajectory and the Kobe plot are biomass and fishing mortality divided by those two. Shape 2 is Schaefer: the peak is at half of $K$, and $F_{MSY} = r/2$.

A new stock or RFMO is a row in `shiny/production/presets.csv`. Leave a value as `NA` to use that row. Type a number to replace it.

## Change this block

```{r inputs}
rfmo  <- "ICCAT"
stock <- "Blue shark"
area  <- "North"

r       <- NA
K       <- NA
m       <- NA
f_ratio <- NA
```

```{r model, echo=FALSE}
candidates <- c(
  file.path("shiny", "production", "presets.csv"),
  file.path("..", "shiny", "production", "presets.csv")
)
preset_path <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)][1]
if (is.na(preset_path)) stop("shiny/production/presets.csv was not found.")
presets <- read.csv(preset_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
hit <- presets[presets$rfmo == rfmo & presets$stock == stock & presets$area == area, ]
if (nrow(hit) != 1) stop("That stock is not in presets.csv. Type r, K, m, and f_ratio.")
hit <- hit[1, ]

if (is.na(r)) r <- hit$r
if (is.na(K)) K <- hit$K
if (is.na(m)) m <- hit$m
if (is.na(f_ratio)) f_ratio <- hit$f_ratio
note <- hit$note

bmsy_over_k <- function(m) m^(-1 / (m - 1))
surplus <- function(B, r, K, m) (r / (m - 1)) * B * (1 - (B / K)^(m - 1))
ref_points <- function(r, K, m) {
  bk <- bmsy_over_k(m)
  Bmsy <- K * bk
  MSY <- surplus(Bmsy, r, K, m)
  list(Bmsy = Bmsy, MSY = MSY, Fmsy = MSY / Bmsy, bk = bk)
}
run_path <- function(r, K, m, f_ratio, ny = 40L) {
  ref <- ref_points(r, K, m)
  dt <- 0.2
  n <- as.integer(ny / dt)
  B <- numeric(n)
  Fr <- numeric(n)
  B[1] <- 0.95 * K
  for (i in seq_len(n - 1L)) {
    Fr[i] <- 0.05 + (f_ratio - 0.05) * ((i - 1) / (n - 1))
    dB <- surplus(B[i], r, K, m) - Fr[i] * ref$Fmsy * B[i]
    B[i + 1] <- max(0.02 * K, B[i] + dt * dB)
  }
  Fr[n] <- f_ratio
  idx <- seq(1, n, by = as.integer(1 / dt))
  data.frame(year = seq_along(idx), B = B[idx], Fr = Fr[idx], Brel = B[idx] / ref$Bmsy)
}
cell_of <- function(b, f) {
  if (b >= 1 && f <= 1) "green"
  else if (b >= 1 && f > 1) "subject to overfishing"
  else if (b < 1 && f <= 1) "overfished"
  else "overfished and subject to overfishing"
}

ref <- ref_points(r, K, m)
path <- run_path(r, K, m, f_ratio)
end <- path[nrow(path), ]
result <- data.frame(
  Item = c("Stock", "r", "K", "Shape", "MSY", "BMSY", "BMSY / K", "FMSY", "Terminal F/FMSY", "End B/BMSY", "End cell"),
  Value = c(
    paste(rfmo, stock, area),
    sprintf("%.2f", r),
    format(round(K), big.mark = ","),
    sprintf("%.2f", m),
    format(round(ref$MSY), big.mark = ","),
    format(round(ref$Bmsy), big.mark = ","),
    sprintf("%.2f", ref$bk),
    sprintf("%.3f", ref$Fmsy),
    sprintf("%.2f", end$Fr),
    sprintf("%.2f", end$Brel),
    cell_of(end$Brel, end$Fr)
  )
)
```

```{r show, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(result, col.names = c("Item", "Value"))
```

`r note`

The path is this production model, run for 40 years while $F/F_{MSY}$ rises from 0.05 to the marked value. It is not the assessment's historical series.

```{r production, echo=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  curve <- data.frame(B = seq(0, K, length.out = 200))
  curve$SP <- surplus(curve$B, r, K, m)
  peak <- data.frame(B = ref$Bmsy, SP = ref$MSY)
  ggplot2::ggplot(curve, ggplot2::aes(B, SP)) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = ref$Bmsy, linetype = 2) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = ref$MSY, linetype = 2) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(data = peak, size = 3) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = "Production function", x = "Biomass (t)", y = "Surplus production (t)") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 13)
}
```

```{r trajectory, echo=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=3.5}
if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  long <- rbind(
    data.frame(year = path$year, value = path$Brel, which = "B / BMSY"),
    data.frame(year = path$year, value = path$Fr, which = "F / FMSY")
  )
  ggplot2::ggplot(long, ggplot2::aes(year, value, colour = which)) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linewidth = 0.3) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c("B / BMSY" = "#1b4f72", "F / FMSY" = "#b03a2e")) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = "Trajectory", x = "Year of the fishery", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

```{r kobe, echo=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  xmax <- max(2.2, path$Brel) * 1.1
  ymax <- max(2.2, path$Fr) * 1.1
  quads <- data.frame(
    xmin = c(0, 1, 0, 1),
    xmax = c(1, xmax, 1, xmax),
    ymin = c(1, 1, 0, 0),
    ymax = c(ymax, ymax, 1, 1),
    fill = c("#e41a1c", "#fdae61", "#fee08b", "#4daf4a")
  )
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_rect(
      data = quads,
      ggplot2::aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
      fill = quads$fill, colour = NA
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linewidth = 0.3) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linewidth = 0.3) +
    ggplot2::geom_path(data = path, ggplot2::aes(Brel, Fr), linewidth = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(data = path[nrow(path), ], ggplot2::aes(Brel, Fr), size = 3.5) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, xmax), ylim = c(0, ymax), expand = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = "Kobe plot", x = "B / BMSY", y = "F / FMSY") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 13)
}
```

Set `m` to 1.5 and render again. $B_{MSY}/K$ moves off 0.50 and MSY moves off the published peak. Someone without a case sets `stock` to `Shortfin mako` and `area` to `North`.
